categories.main_business_segments: Chiyoda Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the footwear business, focusing on the retail and wholesale of shoes through its own stores and subsidiaries. The company previously had an apparel segment, but divested its apparel subsidiary (Mac House) in November 2024 to concentrate on footwear. The group now consists of the parent company and two wholly owned subsidiaries engaged in shoe wholesale.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes the development of private brand (PB) products, such as hands-free shoes and functional footwear tailored to customer needs. It utilizes POS systems for inventory management and has implemented digital marketing and OMO (Online Merges with Offline) strategies to integrate EC and physical stores. Production is largely outsourced to factories in China and other Asian countries, with a focus on cost-effective, high-quality manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chiyoda serves general consumers through its nationwide chain of shoe specialty stores, targeting a wide demographic with affordable, functional, and fashionable footwear. The company also engages in B2B sales through wholesale channels and corporate clients. Its main end markets are the Japanese domestic retail market, with no single customer accounting for more than 10% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Japan, with over 870 retail stores distributed across all major regions including Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kanto, Chubu, Kinki, Chugoku, Shikoku, and Kyushu/Okinawa. Both its retail and wholesale operations are concentrated domestically, and nearly all assets and sales are Japan-based.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chiyoda is positioned downstream in the supply chain as a retailer and wholesaler of finished footwear products. It procures shoes from manufacturers (mainly in Asia), manages inventory and logistics, and sells directly to consumers through its stores and EC, as well as to other businesses via its wholesale subsidiaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include strengthening private brand development, expanding omnichannel (EC and physical store) integration, optimizing inventory through system and logistics improvements, and enhancing digital marketing. There is a strong focus on sustainability, including reducing greenhouse gas emissions and promoting diversity and employee well-being. While there is no formal R&D division, product development is centered on functional, customer-oriented footwear and digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Chiyoda generates revenue primarily through the sale of footwear products in its own retail stores and online shop, as well as through wholesale to other retailers and corporate clients. Revenue is recognized at the point of product delivery to customers. The company also operates a membership app with a points system to drive repeat purchases.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chiyoda is one of Japan’s leading shoe retailers, competing with other national chains such as ABC-Mart and GFOOT, as well as regional and specialty shoe stores. The company differentiates itself through its extensive store network, private brand offerings, and focus on functional, value-oriented products. Its market position is strong in the domestic mass-market footwear segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending February 2025, Chiyoda reported consolidated sales of 91.8 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent shareholders of 2.9 billion yen, with a workforce of 1,171 employees (plus 1,989 part-time/temporary staff). After several years of losses, the company returned to profitability in FY2024 and FY2025, with improved margins and a stable financial base (equity ratio 65.8%). Growth is moderate, with a focus on profitability and operational efficiency rather than aggressive expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chiyoda’s value proposition centers on offering affordable, high-quality, and functional footwear that meets diverse customer needs, including hands-free and comfort-oriented designs. The company emphasizes convenience through its nationwide store network, integrated EC platform, and digital membership services. Differentiation is achieved through proprietary private brands, customer-centric product development, and a strong focus on sustainability and community engagement.
